title: The digest cover · 101
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Friday's digest cover, week four: Highway 101 curving south into Sitka spruce and drizzle, empty, from the shoulder. The bus's road before the bus. The crab, facing away.

panels.composition: A single image: the highway's serpentine bend south, towering ink-black Sitka spruce either side, coastal drizzle in hatching, no vehicle. The road the bus will take on Sunday.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, a zine cover of a coastal highway curving away into towering black Sitka spruce in drizzle, no vehicles, heavy black spotting, no words
image.notes: Cover, week 4. Sunday's last two panels (dw_2000-10-29) without the taillights. The crab in the margin faces away.
